units.source_text: 她用下定决心的口吻说过之后，看来像是过度的狂喜，又像是过度的绝望。

en.t: After she said it in a tone of firm resolve, she seemed to be in a state of excessive ecstasy, or else excessive despair.

units.source_text: 我想，大概在她的意识里只有狂喜才促使她做出那种剧烈的行为，

en.t: I think that, within her own awareness, only ecstasy had probably driven her to commit such a violent act,

units.source_text: 而这种行为的真正力量是柏木带给她的绝望，或是绝望的坚韧的后劲。

en.t: while the true force behind that act was the despair Kashiwagi had brought her, or the tenacious afterforce of that despair.
